purpose: Flag texts that try to move payment or sales off the site, or look like scams, for a support person to review.
method: TF-IDF word + character n-grams; logistic regression (balanced); OR a South African phone-number rule.
data: data/screening.psv - 160 student-authored concepts x 3 languages (65 suspicious, 95 normal incl. hard negatives and everyday reviews).
human_in_the_loop: Never blocks, hides or deletes. A flag only puts the item on support's review list; support decides, and the decision is in the audit log.
limits: Small synthetic dataset; scammers change wording. Unreviewed Setswana/Afrikaans. Expect some false alarms on honest texts that mention payment.
